name: Runia
source:
Being the protagonist's younger sister, Runia is attached to her brother, yet hardly spent time with him until this vacation. Despite her age, Ru is very smart and makes good observations about everything around her. 

Her jokes about her brother's crush are meant to bring out his true feelings towards one of the girls, but she looks forward to spending her own time with him if possible.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thetaugames/kosmos-connections-0]Kickstarter[/url]]
